entities.summary: Joseph Parecattil was an Indian prelate of the Syro-Malabar Church. He served as the 2nd archbishop of Ernakulam from 1956 to 1984, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1969. He was the first cardinal from Kerala and second from India.
